text:
Luke Evangelista was sixth of 401 forwards in Evolving-Hockey's wins above replacement last season in Nashville, driving offense (95th percentile) and taking chances away (96th). He's a Devil now, and the Devils are thriving with him: 63% of the expected goals at five on five when he's on.

The points (10 in 16 games) haven't matched. New Jersey has scored 5.7 fewer goals than expected with him on the ice, which has cost him assists, and that usually swings back. He's a pass-first winger whose comparables in our numbers run from Patrick Kane to Mats Zuccarello, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking called him a setup man.

He had a goal and an assist in a recent overtime win, the kind of night that should come more often. Our range has him at 43 to 66 points for the season, and if the bounces arrive, the top of that is in play.
